_about: Kinds of nature spirits, read by sim/AssetLibrary.cs and sim/Spirits.cs (docs/NATURE.md). When a world is made, each large stretch of a kind's biomes gets a spirit of its own, named from the kind's syllables and the place ("Sylwen, spirit of the Northern Woods"). biomes: names from scripts/world/biomes.gd. domain and deed: the god and the myth a people makes of what the spirit did to it. wrath: what it may do when angry (beasts, overgrowth, wildfire, flood, storm, quake, eruption, drought, tornado, plague). gift: what it gives when content (bloom, bounty, fish, ore, rain, healing). late: a kind only born of land the world did not have at first (the player's volcanoes).

spirits.lore: It is every tree of its woods at once, and counts each one that falls.
It is older than the land and remembers when there was none.
It sleeps under the stone and turns over when it is dug into.
It runs with the herds and lies down in the long grass.
It is patient as the dunes and forgets nothing the wind has buried.
It breathes slowly under the black water, and its breath is fever.
It is the silence after the snow, and the hunger in it.
It was not there when the world was made: a hand from the sky lit it.
